about.title: About
about.h1: Thirty years training the orbit of West African insurance.
about.directorQuote: Promoting insurance training at scale, in Senegal and across the entire CIMA zone — that is the mission entrusted to us. Three decades on, CPFA shapes the technicians, executives and leaders ready to meet the demands of a fast-changing sector.
about.directorRole: Director of CPFA · A decentralised unit of IIA Yaoundé
about.directorPhotoAlt: El Hadji Cheikhou Oumar SECK, Director of CPFA
about.intro1: Founded in 1996 through the joint initiative of the Ministry of Finance and the Senegalese Federation of Insurance Companies, CPFA has become, in three decades, the regional academic reference for technical and managerial careers in insurance.
about.intro2: More than 4,200 graduates work today across the CIMA zone — in insurance companies, at the Insurance Authority, in brokerage firms, and in pan-African institutions such as CICA-Re and Africa-Re.

directorPage.title: Director's address
directorPage.subtitle: Professional Training Centre for the Insurance Industry — A decentralised unit of IIA Yaoundé
directorPage.p1: Welcome to the Professional Training Centre for the Insurance Industry, a decentralised unit of the International Institute of Insurance (IIA) in Yaoundé. Our mission: to deliver insurance training at scale, in Senegal and across the entire CIMA zone.
directorPage.p2: Recognised by the Insurance Authority, CPFA has trained, since its inception, the technicians, executives and leaders capable of meeting the technical, legal and commercial demands of a fast-changing sector.
directorPage.p3: Whether you are a student, a professional in transition or a seasoned executive, you'll find here the path that fits your project: DTA, BTS in Insurance, specialist certifications, topical seminars and access to our dedicated library.
directorPage.signature: — El Hadji Cheikhou Oumar SECK, Director
